responsibility: Builds subdiagnostic notes that explain what a lifetime or region refers to in trait-selection errors. It resolves regions to a user-facing description and source span from generic parameter and HIR context, classifies reusable message prefixes and suffixes for fluent diagnostics, and emits the resulting region explanation as a span note or plain note.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `error_reporting/infer/note_and_explain.rs`, which drives high-level type-error notes and suggestions, this `note_and_explain.rs` is a reusable subdiagnostic component that turns a region into a fluent note with a span and standardized prefix/suffix wording.
